tasks.name: SolveProblemUsingMeansEndsAnalysis
tasks.description: Solve a well-formed problem by iteratively reducing differences between the current state and the goal state.

tasks.name: CompareStates
tasks.description: Compare the current state and the goal state.

tasks.name: FindDifferences
tasks.description: Determine the differences between the current state and the goal state.

tasks.name: SelectDifferenceReducingOperator
tasks.description: Choose an operator that minimizes the difference between the current state and the goal state.

tasks.name: ApplyOperator
tasks.description: Apply the selected operator to produce a new state.

tasks.name: FailureGoal
tasks.description: Represents failure to reduce differences or reach the goal state.

tasks.name: Complete
tasks.description: Represents successful achievement of the goal state.
